outcome: Hemodynamic stability (systolic and diastolic blood pressure)
cohort: 100 pregnant women undergoing elective or emergency cesarean sections under subarachnoid block were included.
finding: Intravenous Phenylephrine was superior to Mephentermine in preventing and managing maternal hypotension during cesarean section under subarachnoid block, showing better hemodynamic stability and fewer maternal side effects without affecting neonatal Apgar scores.
